objects.description: Pointer to a constant, null-terminated C string. This appears as the return type of rogue_shim_version(), which returns a constant version string for the shim. No custom string type is defined in this header.
Pointer to C int. The only mention is as parameter and return type of rogue_shim_add(). No custom integer typedef is defined in this header.

functions.name: rogue_shim_version
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a constant, null-terminated version string for the ActionRoguelike shim. Typical usage is to call this at startup or for diagnostics to retrieve the shim’s version identifier. The returned pointer refers to immutable storage owned by the library.
requirements: Caller must treat the returned string as read-only (do not modify its contents).
Caller must not free or otherwise deallocate the returned pointer.
The returned string is expected to be null-terminated.
Thread-safety and lifetime beyond process duration are not specified; assume the pointer remains valid at least until process shutdown unless documented otherwise.

functions.name: rogue_shim_add
functions.description: Returns the sum of two integers. Intended as a simple utility or test path within the shim.
requirements: Inputs a and b must be representable as int.
The computed sum a + b must fit within the range of int to avoid signed integer overflow (which is undefined behavior in C/C++).
No side effects or allocation are implied; no special initialization is required before calling.
